author: Lasserate
body:
Use a silver coin and a shrine, then start doing dungeons on Boss Mode. At your level, there's 13 bosses + 7k orns for finishing. Call it 15k-20k orns per dungeon. You'll also usually have quests to turn in: kill Tiamat, complete 4 dungeons, etc. 

Use a dowsing rod with the luck shrine and you'll gain back as many keys as you use.

author: TheSaiguy
body:
Looks like people already have told you to pop buffs and do boss runs, so I say just casually farm normal mobs. Thats all there's really left to do. I just got Archdruid for my 2m last week. I'm at about 700k orns and I don't travel a ton. Just play the game and have fun.

P.S. a certain kind of t8 mob drops a lot more Orns. If you really want to get it I would suggest that, but make sure your gear is up to par.

author: Vaskov
body: Ive grinded 90% of my orns sat at home with shrines and buffs. If you activate them all you should be able to grind 50k orns an hour and just take it from there. The next class takes 3.5m orns so be prepared for that. If you are worried about overleveling stop doing raid bosses. I managed to get 3.5m orns within 4 levels after 175 without doing raid bosses. After 175 grinding mobs you can get about 80k per hour if you can kill nothren mobs easily enough.
